context: A teen and his dad watch an Olympics match on TV
purpose: Teach: オリンピック/キャンプ/プレイヤー/ブロック/シュート/ゲスト/大勢/進ま

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: おっ、始まったぞ。オリンピックのバスケ、決勝戦だ。
lines.en: Oh, it's starting. The Olympic basketball final.
lines.style: Casual dad tone, excited but relaxed, settling onto the couch with snacks.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やった、待ってた!あの背の高いプレイヤー、すごく上手いんだよ。
lines.en: Yes, I was waiting! That tall player is really good.
lines.style: Energetic teen voice, leaning forward, fan-boy enthusiasm clearly audible.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ほう、詳しいな。代表チームは夏に強化キャンプをやってたらしいぞ。
lines.en: Wow, you know a lot. The national team apparently did a training camp this summer.
lines.style: Impressed paternal tone, slightly teasing, sharing trivia he saw on news.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 今のシュート見た?ディフェンスのブロックを抜いて決めた!
lines.en: Did you see that shot? He got past the block and scored!
lines.style: Excited teen yelling, pointing at the screen, can barely sit still.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 見た見た。それにしても会場、大勢のファンで埋まってるな。
lines.en: I saw, I saw. The venue is packed with so many fans.
lines.style: Calmer adult observation, sipping a beer, marveling at the crowd size.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 解説のゲストが元日本代表の人だってさ。話、面白いね。
lines.en: The guest commentator is a former Japan national player. His commentary is interesting.
lines.style: Informative teen tone, half-watching the broadcaster graphic, casual approval.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うーん、後半は点が思うように進まないな。粘ってるけど。
lines.en: Hmm, the score isn't moving the way we want in the second half. They're hanging in there though.
lines.style: Concerned dad muttering, arms crossed, tense but hopeful sigh.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 大丈夫、まだ逆転できるよ。父さん、ポップコーン取って!
lines.en: It's okay, they can still come back. Dad, pass the popcorn!
lines.style: Optimistic teen energy, hand outstretched, eyes glued to the TV screen.
